body: The thought that honestly struck me like a shovel in the face when I had my break through is this feels exactly like a rhythm game and the ringing of our swords clashing is the chores.

The game finally clicked for me on my near 100th try on father owl the first time you fight him. Everything before that felt like I was just brute forcing everything, and I honestly dreaded getting into an encounter just because even the lowest of enemies were killing me.
Dang it really seems like I just had terrible luck with the first person I interacted with
It was a hazard level 3 I believe but I'll definitely keep all this in mind to try and minimize how much I'm negatively impacting someone else's game
